_note: Copy this file to artifact.local.json (already gitignored) and fill in your own machine-specific values. Only `llm_base_urls` is actually read from this file (by skill_refiner/pipeline.py and scripts/_llm_config.py, as a fallback after env vars / --base-url); every other key here is documentation of an env var or CLI flag you set yourself -- see README > 'Local configuration' for exactly where each is read in code.

embedding_cache_dir.wired: No env var yet. Default is <repo_root>/.cache/skill_refiner/summary_clustering (resolved relative to the repo, gitignored). Override by passing cache_dir= explicitly to ClusteredTraceDrivenRefiner(...) or cluster_summaries(...).

llm_base_urls.wired: Read from artifact.local.json if present, keyed by provider name under llm_base_urls. `eval_proxy` is the only provider shipped -- it is the one the configuration of record used, and both call sites fail loudly on any other name rather than falling back. Resolution order: --base-url flag (scripts only) / SKILL_REFINER_BASE_URL_EVAL_PROXY env var (skill_refiner.pipeline) or LLM_BASE_URL (scripts/_llm_config.py), then this file's llm_base_urls.eval_proxy. No baked-in default: both call sites raise/exit loudly, naming the missing provider, instead of silently trying a placeholder host.

llm_api_key_env_var.wired: one of env vars LLM_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY (checked in that order), or a --secrets-file JSON with the same keys

llm_secrets_file.wired: --secrets-file CLI flag; filename pattern *.secrets.json is already gitignored so any local secrets file you create here is never tracked

openai_base_url.wired: env var OPENAI_BASE_URL (Trace2Skill baseline code, independent of scripts/_llm_config.py)

spreadsheetbench_data_path.wired: --data-path CLI flag; the default points at a repo-relative baselines/trace2skill/data/... path that only exists after you fetch the official SpreadsheetBench dataset (see README)
